description_en: Queries the information about security rule sets of a tenant. The information includes the name and description of security rules, and instances associated with security rules
description_zh: 调用GetStandardGroup接口可以获取到租户下已有的安全规则集信息，包含规则名称、描述及规则关联实例的类型等信息
name: GetStandardGroup

parameters.help_en: The security rule set ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465940.html operation to obtain the ID of the security rule set
parameters.help_zh: 安全规则集ID。您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465940.html接口获取安全规则集ID
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the DMS console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message that is returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

StandardGroup.description_en: The information about the security rule set

Description.description_en: The description of the security rule set

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the security rule set

GroupMode.description_en:
The control mode. Valid values:

NONE_CONTROL: Flexible Management
STABLE: Stable Change
COMMON: Security Collaboration
GroupMode.description_zh:
管控模式，返回值如下：
NONE_CONTROL：自由操作。
STABLE：稳定变更。
COMMON：安全协同

GroupName.description_en: The name of the security rule set

LastMenderId.description_en: The ID of the user who last modified the security rules
LastMenderId.description_zh: 最近修改安全规则的用户ID

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
